Reference impl: mne.time_frequency.tfr_array_morlet (Gramfort et al. 2013). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the Morlet scalogram with MNE tfr_array_morlet (matched freqs + n_cycles) and compares to waveletTransform's; reports the full-TFR correlation (0.9998), the marginal-spectrum correlation (0.9999), the normalization scale (0.49), the dominant scalogram frequency (10 Hz = alpha), and the alpha-band power fraction (0.65)
